---
title: "Shiny App (beta)"
---

<!-- Not listed on the website. See the "internal" section in _pkgdown.yml. -->

<style>
.shiny-app-frame {
  position: fixed;
  left: 0;
  top: 50px;
  bottom: 0;
  right: 0;
}
.shiny-app-frame iframe {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  border: none;
}
</style>

<div class="shiny-app-frame">
<iframe id="shiny-app"></iframe>
</div>

<script>
  const appOrigin = "https://milanwiedemann-opencodecounts-beta.share.connect.posit.cloud";

  // Pass URL parameters on to the app, e.g. ?dataset=icd10&codes=F411
  document.getElementById("shiny-app").src =
    appOrigin + "/" + window.location.search;

  // Show the app's selection in the address bar, so the link can be shared
  window.addEventListener("message", function (event) {
    if (event.origin !== appOrigin) return;
    if (!event.data || event.data.type !== "opencodecounts-url-query") return;
    history.replaceState(null, "", window.location.pathname + event.data.query);
  });
</script>
